backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor with no functions.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence mapping features to impacted files, components, and test IDs for transition animation additions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides descriptive summaries of key frontend files including App, animations, Tailwind config, Moments page, and transition overlay.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles and theme variables defining light/dark OKLCH color tokens and applying background/foreground rules.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entrypoint mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with a romantic message carousel, final-slide Yes/No logic, transition animation trigger, and navigation to the Moments page.
frontend/src/components/LoveTransitionOv: Animated full‑screen overlay showing floating emojis, balloons, and hearts that runs for 3 seconds before calling onComplete.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches a backend actor, updating when the Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks handling Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, status tracking, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, extensive OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes, and custom romantic animations like floating hearts and heartbeat.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with react-query and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/Moments.tsx: Renders a romantic themed Moments page with animated hearts, background layers, a message card, and gallery layout.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, romantic palette extensions, fonts, and animation/keyframe extensions.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and specifies feature requests related to adding a Valentine's transition animation on Yes click.
